This is my card for **Take-home 2**. Full instructions and hints: [ROADMAP.md](https://github.com/data-science-ucsb/sports-stats-explorer/blob/main/ROADMAP.md#take-home-2-make-your-first-pull-request)

## Steps
- [ ] Make a branch: `git checkout -b add-<your-name>`
- [ ] Create `members/<your-github-username>.md` with your name, your year or major, and your favorite team or sport
- [ ] Commit it and push it to your fork (`origin`)
- [ ] Open a pull request to the club repo, with `Closes #<this card's number>` in the description

## Done when
My pull request is open on GitHub.

## When I'm finished
Nothing to do! The `Closes #...` line moves this card to **In review**, and to **Done** when a lead merges it.

**Challenge (optional):** open a pull request for your `sql/top_rebounders.sql` from Take-home 1, with `Closes #<your Take-home 1 card number>` in it.
